context: Philips Manager Recognition Award — 2000 Recognition points for Philips behavior 'Team up to win'. Awarded by Sundaresan Jagadeesan on 3 January 2020. raw_text: Congratulations! Dattatreya Vellal. You have been awarded 2000 Recognition points for demonstrating the Philips behavior Team up to win. Thankyou for your collaboration and team work in making the .craft program evaluation a great success in 2019! Thanks for your great contribution. Keep up the good work. Sundaresan Jagadeesan.
